diagnosis: The staging Vitest snapshot inspection endpoint loads test snapshots from the filesystem using user-supplied suiteId and testName parameters. In multi-tenant staging environments where automated integration tests run against tenant-specific sandbox datasets, snapshots contain confidential onboarding payloads, API tokens, and customer PII. Because the endpoint does not verify that the staging user has rights to suiteId, any staging user can read sensitive test snapshots from other tenant sandboxes.
exploit_request:
GET /api/staging/vitest/snapshots/tenant_banking_enterprise/customer_onboarding_flow HTTP/1.1
Host: staging-qa.platform.cloud
Authorization: Bearer staging_tester_guest_token
